sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 2008
ACT IV OF 2008
SINDH ESSENTIAL
COMMODITIES PRICE CONTROL
AND PREVENTION OF
PROFITEERING AND
HOARDING (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2008
An Act to further amend
the Sindh Essential Commodities
Price Control and
Prevention of Profiteering
and Hoarding Act,
2005
[Gazettee
of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
11nd September, 2008]
No.PAS/Legis-B-08/2008, dated
11-9-2008.---The Sindh Essential Commodities Price
Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding (Amendment) Bill, 2008
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 15th August, 2008 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 2nd September, 2008 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to further amend the Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and Prevention of
Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---This Act may
be called the Sindh Essential Commodities Price
Control and Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding (Amendment) Act, 2008.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act No.IX of 2006.---In
the Sindh Essential Commodities Price Control and
Prevention of Profiteering and Hoarding Act, 2005, in section 8, for the words
"three months", the words "six months" and for the words
"ten thousand rupees", the words "thirty thousand rupees"
shall be substituted.
